# Mixed automatic and explicit cell width preferences

Original OOXML controls authored by `tools/mixed_cell_width_preferences_fixture.py`.
No corpus XML, images or fonts are included. The generator uses only Python's
standard library and fixed ZIP metadata. The reference application exported
the exact source read-only; `tools/record_mixed_cell_width_preferences.py`
extracts colored cell-fill bounds from that PDF independently of the app.
The source, cases and PDF are hash-bound by a unit test.

Sixteen cases cross AutoFit/fixed layout, smaller/larger first-cell widths,
and absent/automatic/explicit merged headers plus an explicit full-width
footer. The saved grid is 3000/1800/1200 twips; the table requests 6000 twips;
the first two ordinary cells request 2400 or 3600, and 1440 twips, while the
third is automatic. Two body rows use short original labels and unique fills.

The fixed-layout browser comparison now passes all eight native cases. It also
checks no-edit preservation, body editing, exact undo and reopening. Fixed
merged preferences are deferred until single-column requests are known, then
resolved from smaller to enclosing spans. Automatic or omitted merged widths
retain their current span in fixed layout; they do not disappear when a later
cell replaces an inferred share.

The AutoFit comparison now passes all eight original cases at the unchanged
0.2pt cell-boundary tolerance. Explicit single-column preferences remain held
while automatic columns absorb spare width. Explicit merged preferences infer
one unknown width, or resize their span together when several remain unknown.
Merged content maxima account for the room already supplied by explicit cells.
Content minima remain enforced, including noWrap.

`nowrap.docx` is an original paired variant produced by
`tools/mixed_cell_width_no_wrap_fixture.py`: the second and third body cells
have noWrap. Its native PDF and hash-bound reference add sixteen cases.
`mixed-cell-width-four` adds six original four-column cases with two automatic
columns, generated by `tools/mixed_cell_width_four_fixture.py`. All 38 cases
pass strict native geometry checks plus no-edit preservation, editing, exact
undo and reopening. No font binaries or corpus content are included.

These controls establish this mixed-preference behavior, not complete AutoFit
fidelity. Corpus #64 remains partial: its isolated table still differs by up
to 0.91pt horizontally, down from 27.69pt before this correction.

Relevant ECMA-376 Part 1 sections are 17.4.49 (tblGrid), 17.4.63 (tblW),
17.4.71 (tcW), and 17.18.87 (ST_TblLayoutType). The layout guidance permits
alternative algorithms; no normative reference/spec contradiction is claimed.
